Resolves #20681

`RowGeometry` now keeps an extra height per record beside the measured ones: `setExtraHeights(heights)` adds it to the row's height, offsets and `totalHeight`, while `measuredMean` stays the mean of the measured heights only, so an expanded row no longer inflates the estimate for unmeasured rows. `grid.View#setRowExtraHeights(heights)` applies extras through the same scroll-stable path as `setRowHeights`, holding them during a thumb drag and dropping held ones on a store replacement.

Evidence: L1 (unit specs, `useVdomWorker: false`) → L1 required (every AC is a unit assertion). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 `measuredMean` ignores extras (32, 32, extra 300 → 32) | CI-covered: `RowGeometry.spec.mjs` › an extra height adds to its row and leaves the measured mean alone |
| AC-2 offsets and `totalHeight` include extras; removing one restores them | CI-covered: same test (`0` and `null` both remove) |
| AC-3 `clearHeights()` keeps extras | CI-covered: `RowGeometry.spec.mjs` › clearing the known heights keeps the extra heights |
| AC-4 the row at the scroll offset holds still when an extra above it changes | CI-covered: `AnchorCorrection.spec.mjs` › an extra height above the anchor row moves the scroll offset along, and so does its removal (correction `300`, then `-300`, one each) |
| AC-5 fixed-height grids unaffected; `setRowExtraHeights` returns `false` | CI-covered: `RowGeometry.spec.mjs` › without contentSizedRows the grid keeps index × rowHeight |

## Deltas from ticket
- The full pass now resolves record ids when only extras are known (it used to skip that while no measured height existed), so an extra on a never-measured row adds to the estimate (`RowGeometry.spec.mjs` › an extra height on a row without a known height adds to the estimate).
- A new store clears extras along with measured heights, in `RowGeometry#afterSetStore` and for extras held during a thumb drag (`AnchorCorrection.spec.mjs` › extra heights held during a thumb drag do not outlive a store replacement).
- `resetRowHeights()` (a `wrapText` change) keeps extras, like the font refresh.
- `setHeights()` and `setExtraHeights()` share the per-row update of the offset pass (`updateRowHeight()`); `setHeights()` behaves as before.

- After: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/grid`: 511 passed.
- Every unit directory except `ai`, `buildScripts` and `e2e`: 6080 passed, 2 skipped, 13 failed. The same 13 (Main window open/move, dashboard dock imports, learn corpus links, unit run policy, canvas remotes, portal discussions) fail without this change on this machine too, so they come from the local Windows setup. `buildScripts` does not load here because the Windows checkout gives `merge-comment.yml` CRLF line endings.
